raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 6
, Reason for Mistake: After the Planner explicitly instructed the WebSurfer to retrieve definitive country-of-origin information from authoritative sources and extract the production country, the WebSurfer did not open or read the Wikipedia/IMDb/Unifrance pages. Instead, they repeatedly ran the same SERP queries without clicking through, leaving the conflict unresolved and risking reliance on an incorrect snippet (United Kingdom). This failure to follow instructions prevented reaching the correct conclusion about In My Skin’s origin.
